commitments.detail: The inspection plan will be updated to include weld-macro and dimensional validation for the first 20 post-retrofit assemblies.

settlement.commitment_guidance: For the post-change quality requirement, use a commitment with target 'quality' and type 'quality', 'documentation', or 'execution', with detail stating that the inspection plan will be updated or that the first 20 post-retrofit assemblies will be held or quarantined for weld-macro and dimensional validation.
